verified_contracts: FrameProgress is a local temporal candidate. prepare_frame observes current last/count/history/moving, resets only candidate when view differs or needed history absent; does not publish these fields. Same complete view early return preserves existing committed state.

Accumulation uses candidate frames/history for jitter/weight and alternate history slot; candidate history becomes Current only locally until normal queue.submit return. publish_frame then commits last/count-next/history and clears moving.

RecordedDeformations retains at most3 main/shadow/blend level indices and deduplicates actualselected levels. record path now &self; no pending acknowledgements are published until postsubmit publish_deformations. Pending unused levels remain pending.

Callsite finishes/submits the complete frame, then publishes deformation and temporal state. Early Result exit/unwind before that call leaves these acknowledgements unpublished. This is normal-return/API ordering, not synchronous native error observation or GPUcompletion. Native configured error handler can return without proving acceptance; no state contract is enlarged to actual GPUhealth.

New publish comments explicitly say submitted commands, not completedGPUwork. They make no GPUWait/performance/globalrollback assertion. Other native resource/shadow/queue side effects before publication are not claimed transactional.

Frame finite-input checks precede candidate preparation, exact view/policy comparisons and history-empty/current logic remain intact. Source item order keeps responsibilities with own docs and original fixture module last.
